🎲 Guessing Game
code:
import random

secret = random.randint(1, 20)
print("I picked a number 1-20. You get 4 tries!")
for attempt in range(1, 5):
    g = int(input(f"Try {attempt}: "))
    if g == secret:
        print("🎉 Correct!")
        break
    print("Too high!" if g > secret else "Too low!")
else:
    print(f"Out of tries — it was {secret}.")
